lede: Houston Texans carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#26 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Tennessee Titans +5.9 with a fair total of 39.5 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tennessee Titans pass offence vs Houston Texans pass defence, which sits −0.344 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Houston Texans and Tennessee Titans have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
